name_input: J D JONES & CO. PVT. LTD
court_cases: Multiple Indian court cases confirmed on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org), company appears as a party in Calcutta High Court and tax tribunals. Key records: (1) 'J.D. Jones & Co. Pvt. Ltd. vs Commissioner of C.Ex.' — Customs, Excise and Gold Tribunal, Calcutta, 01.11.2002, 2003(154)ELT106(TRI-KOLKATA) — company as appellant, excise dispute; (2) 'Stoplik Services (I) Pvt. Ltd. vs J.D. Jones & Co.' — Calcutta High Court, hearings 18.02.2010, 31.03.2011, 18.04.2011, 03.05.2011, 06.06.2011 (Justice Nadira Patherya / Sanjib Banerjee) — company as defendant/respondent, civil suit; (3) 'Allahabad Bank vs J.D. Jones & Co.' — Calcutta High Court, 13.02.2014 (Justice Debangsu Basak) — company as defendant, bank recovery matter; (4) 'M/s J.D. Jones & Co. Pvt. Ltd. vs Union of India' — Calcutta High Court, 24.02.2022 (Justice Rajarshi Bharadwaj) — company as petitioner, writ; (5) 'J.D. Jones & Company Private Limited vs D.C.I.T., Circle-6, Kolkata' — ITAT Kolkata, I.T.A. No. 381/Kol/2020, AY 2010-11, order 05.05.2021 — company as appellant, income tax appeal; (6) 'Gillanders Arbuthnot & Co. Ltd vs J.D. Jones & Company Limited' — Calcutta High Court (Appellate Side), 20.09.2024 (Justice Rajasekhar Mantha), appeal described in the order as 'more than forty years old' — company as respondent. Also historic: 'J.D. Jones And Co. Ltd. vs Ranjit Roy And Ors.', Calcutta HC, 22.11.1926 (AIR 1927 Cal 682) and 'Another vs The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation', Calcutta HC, 11.02.2014 (Justice Sanjib Banerjee) — company as petitioner. Status of each: no adverse final ruling against the company identified in the search snippets; matters are ordinary commercial, tax and excise litigation. Per project rules, litigation is not a rejection ground.
news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or adverse media found. Note: web_search (SearX) backend was unreachable ('Connection refused') and Bing returned degraded/irrelevant results for all queries, so negative-news coverage could not be exhaustively screened — this is a research limitation, not a clean bill of health.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'J D Jones' combined with Russia/sanctions/insolvency returned 'No matching results'. No customs, B-L or trade record located. Status: not found, not confirmed either way.
note: Risk-only review. Entity is real and long-established: Indian Kanoon shows continuous litigation presence from 1926 to 2024, and the 2002 CESTAT order describes the company as 'engaged in the manufacture of' iron oxide powder, graphite powder and colloidal preparations — consistent with the declared metallurgy/minerals profile. Sanctions: OFAC SDN/Non-SDN list search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov, SDN list last updated 23.11.2026) was reachable but is a JavaScript form that returned no queryable results via direct fetch; no name match was found through any other channel, so sanctions_hit is recorded as null (not screened conclusively) rather than a confirmed negative. UN/EU/UK/BIS lists not separately queried — same limitation. Credit rating: no public rating found (company appears to be an unrated private limited company); recorded null, not estimated. Court cases are ordinary commercial/tax/excise/bank matters spanning decades and are noted neutrally per Rule 2 — they are not grounds for rejection. No insolvency, liquidation or winding-up order was located. Recommendation: retain in database; re-run sanctions screening against OFAC/EU/UK/BIS consolidated lists and a paid credit bureau (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE or CIBIL) when tooling permits.
